figurative_meaning_en: Shrinking or curling up, withdrawing into oneself
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে লজ্জায় গুটিসুটি করে কোণে বসে আছে।
ঠান্ডায় সবাই গুটিসুটি মেরে শুয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is curled up in the corner out of shyness.
Everyone is huddled up sleeping due to the cold.
note: Onomatopoeic expression mimicking the action of folding or shrinking
